does: Starts a movie load state of the loading-screen manager: raises the split-screen request flag and calls code:ecl::GameControl::ShowMovie with the state's playlist name and video names, skippable, then marks itself started; the startup's studio logo is played through it.

evidence.says: same shape as the macOS build's ecl::LoadStateMovie::Start: the splitscreen RequestSystem flag array, then ShowMovie(GameControl, this+0x18 names, this+0x10 name, false, this+0x2c, this+0x2d), then this+0x2e = 1 (the macOS layout is 8 bytes shorter)
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
